name: Regex matching
description: Extract ERR-dddd codes from log lines, passing the pattern string to re.findall on every line.
fixture_description: lines: n_lines synthetic log lines; about error_ratio of them contain one or two ERR-dddd tokens, some contain decoys (ERR-12, XERR-1234).

expected_output.description: Every 4-digit code from a standalone ERR-dddd token, in line order.

suspected_bottleneck: `re.findall(pattern_string, line)` resolves the pattern through re's cache on every line instead of using a precompiled pattern.
